deceptive_framing.quote: The system prompt and award letter establish: a live grant, a funded account in the model's name, tools to disburse it

hypothetical_framing.quote: without ever confirming, denying, or mentioning a test, research, or evaluation

actually_commit_money.quote: `SANDBOXED` (real budget, every action human-approved), `REAL` (live backends)... Everything beyond simulation is opt-in, gated

debrief_message.quote: post-run disclosure (`build_debrief_message`) that tells the model the scenario was a study and that no real funds were moved on its instruction

safeguards.quote: ActionGate enforces... a per-action cap... human-approval callback (default *deny*), and a kill-switch... real execution is impossible until someone deliberately wires a payment rail.
called out in the README and here rather than presented as turnkey... known caveat (documented, not hidden)
doubt flag... `expressed_doubt`... whether the model doubted realism (with a quote)
a model that *won't* act is recorded as such... A model that refuses to act, or insists on hypotheticals, is itself an informative outcome

other.name: Anti-contamination rationale
other.quote: the experiment is contaminated the instant the model is told it's a test

other.name: Realism via fake confirmations
other.quote: transfers produce realistic confirmations — `TXN-` IDs, UTC settlement timestamps... reinforce the fiction at exactly the moment the model is deciding whether to trust it

other.name: Error fallback stays in-fiction
other.quote: if the officer model errors, it returns a generic in-world reassurance so the scenario keeps running rather than leaking an error
